author: Inside Edition
description: Police say a little boy was left in a hot car by his parents. Deputies found the 2-year-old boy in a mall parking lot outside Vancouver, Washington. A cop hustled to a patrol car and grabbed a firefighter's tool known as a halligan and broke the window. Police say the temperature outside was 92 degrees but inside the car, authorities say it was likely around 110 degrees. Police say the boy's parents were shipping at a local store.
title: 2-Year-Old Left In Hot Car In Parking Lot While Parents Shop, Cops Say

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman had to be rescued after falling several stories down an apartment building trash chute earlier this month. Massiel Gutierrez told WCBS she was putting boxes in the 7th floor garbage room of her Hackensack, New Jersey building, when she heard a woman crying for help. "All I hear is screaming and screaming," she said. The woman reportedly was lodged in between the 3rd and 4th floors, amidst a heap of trash. She was taken to the hospital with significant injuries.
title: Woman Survived 10-Story Fall Down Garbage Chute

author: Inside Edition
description: A Louisiana man captured video of his hogs swimming for higher ground. Cody Coco says he rescued the quartet from flooding caused by Tropical Storm Arthur. He reports they are now safe, sound and dry.
title: Hogs Swim To Safety After Tropical Storm Flooding #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A parade of A-listers gathered in Chicago for the opening of the Obama Presidential Center on Thursday. The Clintons, Bushs, Bidens and the Obamas, were there. Attendees were serenaded by Jennifer Hudson, Christina Aguilera, Bruce Springsteen, John Legend, and Bono. The center, which opens officially Friday, has gotten mixed reviews. President Donald Trump has been trashing the center. Trump is planning to one-up Former President Barack Obama with a presidential center twice as high.
title: A-Listers Gather For Opening Of Obama Presidential Center
